These two fixtures were generated by the installed Omarchy template engine
from its Catppuccin and Catppuccin Latte palettes on 14 September 2026.
The TSV files are `omarchy-theme-color --all` output. The JSON files are the
engine's rendering of `contrib/omarchy/spotifast.json.tpl`.

They check that first-launch setup matches the palette Omarchy generates on
later theme changes. Generating them used an isolated writable home directory
in a mount namespace; no desktop theme or user hook was changed.

Omarchy source: https://github.com/basecamp/omarchy
